assumptions: Prompts of a split are treated as an independent sample of the authoring distribution; repetitions are independent given p, a prompt's per-repetition probability of a valid first attempt; the SPEC-069 scorer is reused unchanged; the gate A noise pilot (REQ-032) supplies the variance and correlation used for sizing; claude-code on the subscription route; ADR 0046 Proposed.
compatibility: New modules and new gate rules for splits frozen under this specification only; SPEC-078 and SPEC-079 protocols, splits, analysis modules and the scorer are unchanged; existing Lightning configurations keep parallel 1 and target kind skill.
domain: Statistical machinery for Braid Lightning: gate A over prompts that name the product, paired candidate selection, audit set, drift controls and replay, for one host and model per run.
execution_contract: executionAuthorization stays false; simulations spend no quota; any real rollout needs the recorded simulation evidence, a frozen protocol (for development pilots, a pilot freeze) and the owner's yes; subscription route only, EUR 0; no promotion.
hypotheses: H1: paired selection on one fixed slice picks an epsilon-good candidate more often than independent means on n = 5 (simulation). H2: the exact all-fail bound has at least nominal coverage (simulation). H3: gate A type I error at the boundary is at most alpha (simulation). A null or negative simulation result completes the protocol and blocks real runs until redesigned.
observation_contract: Per-trial validFirstAttempt from scripts/spec069_scoring.score_case; per-prompt pass at >= 2 of 3; exact Clopper-Pearson lower bound of the passing share and exact upper bound of the all-fail rate; per-class passing counts; paired per-prompt differences for selection; per-rollout versions and invocation counts.

scenarios.given: a prompt with repetition outcomes valid, valid, invalid
scenarios.then: the prompt passes; with valid, invalid, missing it fails
scenarios.when: the gate A analysis scores it

requirements.text: Gate A unit and outcome. Gate A MUST score prompts that name the product. The unit is the prompt; a prompt passes when at least 2 of its 3 repetitions are `validFirstAttempt` under the unchanged SPEC-069 scorer, giving one binary result per prompt. A missing rollout result counts as a failed repetition.

scenarios.given: 88 passing prompts of 100 and α = 0.05
scenarios.then: it equals the exact Clopper–Pearson value 0.8128 to four decimals

scenarios.given: a candidate pool with known per-repetition probabilities of a valid first attempt, the measured within-prompt correlation and, separately, a template-clustered scenario
scenarios.then: its type I error at the boundary does not exceed α within simulation error in the independent scenario, and its type I error, power and coverage are reported for the clustered scenario

requirements.text: Exact lower bound on the passing share. Gate A MUST report the exact one-sided Clopper–Pearson lower bound of the passing share at the α of OD-1. The pass threshold for the bound is 0.80, inherited from SPEC-078 OD-1.

scenarios.given: 2 prompts at 0/3 out of 100 and α = 0.05
scenarios.then: it equals 0.0616 to four decimals

scenarios.given: prompt populations with known θ
scenarios.then: its coverage is at least 1 − α within simulation error for every θ in the grid

requirements.text: All-fail upper bound. Gate A MUST report the exact one-sided Clopper–Pearson upper bound of the all-fail rate θ = E[(1−p)³], with p a prompt's per-repetition probability of a valid first attempt, estimated by the count of prompts with 0 of 3 valid repetitions, together with its comparison against the preregistered threshold of OD-2. The rule "no prompt is 0/3" is not used for splits frozen under this specification.

scenarios.given: a run with one unreviewed 0/3 prompt
scenarios.then: the verdict is held and names the prompt

requirements.text: Review of each 0/3 prompt. Each prompt at 0/3 MUST be held until the owner classifies it as `model` or `instrument` on redacted transcripts; disagreements are recorded verbatim. The verdict is `held` while any 0/3 prompt is unreviewed.

scenarios.given: two instrument findings and a cap of three
scenarios.then: the first two reserve prompts in frozen order replace them and both originals stay in the report

scenarios.given: instrument findings above the cap
scenarios.then: the verdict is invalidated

requirements.text: Instrument replacement from a frozen reserve. For a split frozen under this specification, a prompt classified `instrument` MUST be replaced by the next prompt of a reserve frozen by sha256 with the split, in a preregistered draw order, up to the cap of OD-8, under the safeguards adopted in OD-18; the replaced prompt and its results stay in the record. Exceeding the cap invalidates the run. SPEC-079, where `instrument` invalidates the run, is unchanged.

scenarios.given: a class with 4 of 10 prompts passing
scenarios.then: the gate is not met whatever the bounds

requirements.text: Class rule. Gate A MUST also require that every class of the split has at least half of its prompts passing.

scenarios.given: a protocol declaring 2 repetitions without a recorded decision
scenarios.then: it refuses

requirements.text: Three repetitions. Gate A MUST use 3 repetitions per prompt. A different number needs a new owner decision recorded before the split is frozen.

scenarios.given: two candidates and a slice
scenarios.then: both are scored on identical prompt and repetition identifiers and the decision statistic is computed from paired differences

scenarios.given: known-p candidates with the within-prompt correlation of the noise pilot
scenarios.then: paired selection picks an ε-good candidate (within ε of OD-3 of the best) at a rate at least as high as n = 5, reported with its simulation interval
scenarios.when: paired selection and n = 5 independent means are simulated (SIM)

requirements.text: Paired comparison on one fixed slice. Elimination MUST rank candidates by per-prompt paired differences in the valid rate, averaged over repetitions, with every surviving candidate evaluated on the same fixed slice of prompts and repetitions; independent means are never the decision statistic. The finer valid-rate difference is used only to screen; the replacement test of REQ-011 uses per-prompt majority pass, the gate A estimand.

scenarios.given: pilot variance, α, power, margin δ and target advantage Δ
scenarios.then: it returns the plan.md formula value computed with Δ − δ

requirements.text: Slice sized from the pilot. The slice size MUST come from the gate A noise pilot of REQ-032 (variance of paired differences, discordance rate) through the formula in plan.md, at the α and power of OD-1 and OD-4 and the margin δ and target advantage Δ > δ of OD-3.

scenarios.given: three candidates in a round
scenarios.then: all three receive the same item identifiers before any is dropped

requirements.text: Synchronized elimination. Elimination MUST be synchronized: in each round all surviving candidates see the same new items. The elimination rule is the one the owner picks in OD-11 after the simulation comparison.

scenarios.given: a challenger whose paired majority-pass advantage on the confirmation slice is below the margin, although its elimination-slice advantage exceeds it
scenarios.then: the incumbent is kept and the elimination-slice result is not used in the test

requirements.text: Incumbent kept unless the margin is met. The incumbent MUST be kept unless a challenger beats it by the preregistered margin δ of OD-3 under the test of OD-11, on per-prompt majority pass, on the confirmation slice of REQ-034, at the family-wise α of OD-16.

scenarios.given: a selection run
scenarios.then: no audit item identifier appears in any selection input

requirements.text: Audit set. An audit set of the size of OD-5 MUST be frozen by sha256, disjoint by normalized text and fingerprint from every selection slice, development set and held-out split. The selected candidate is reported on it with an exact confidence interval.

scenarios.given: a host version change between two sessions
scenarios.then: it stops with a re-baseline required refusal

scenarios.given: a session
scenarios.then: the block order is reproducible from the seed and contains the A/A anchors

requirements.text: Drift controls. Every real run under this specification MUST pin the host CLI version with auto-update off and the model; record the host, model and plugin versions per rollout; include A/A anchors each session, drawn from development prompts only during held-out runs; interleave arms in randomized blocks with a recorded seed; and require a new baseline after any host or model change.

scenarios.given: a recorded rollout
scenarios.then: every listed field is present and a missing field fails the report

requirements.text: Run metadata. Run reports MUST carry `configDigest`, per-rollout host CLI, model and plugin versions, the tool-call count and whether the skill was invoked.

scenarios.given: a twin run whose invocation rate is below the threshold
scenarios.then: it fails and the held-out run is refused

requirements.text: Gate 0 invocation tripwire. Gate 0 of every split frozen under SPEC-090 or SPEC-091 MUST reject the held-out run when the invocation rate on a development twin is below the preregistered threshold of OD-9.

scenarios.given: a recorded journal
scenarios.then: both decisions and their hashes are identical

requirements.text: Replayable decisions. Every selection and gate decision MUST be a pure function of a journal (results, seeds, frozen hashes); replaying a journal gives an identical decision.

scenarios.given: a protocol without the simulation record hash
scenarios.then: the runner refuses before any rollout

requirements.text: Simulation before any real run. The runner MUST reject a real run under this specification unless its protocol carries both the hash of the recorded simulation evidence (T004 to T007, plus T019 for runs sized from the pilot) and the owner's recorded yes; a development pilot (T020) needs T004 to T007 and its own pilot freeze (REQ-039) instead of T019.

scenarios.given: a configuration with parallel 2 and no recorded OD-6 adoption
scenarios.then: it refuses

requirements.text: Runner concurrency. The runner MUST reject a `parallel` value above 1 unless the owner adopts concurrency in OD-6; if adopted, A/A anchors measure the effect and a decision replay is identical for any `parallel` value.

scenarios.given: a GEPA round over three candidates
scenarios.then: the choice comes from the paired selection module, not from GEPA's minibatch-mean acceptance against the parent or APO's top-k beam

requirements.text: Optimizer selection steps. The GEPA and APO selection steps (`agent_braid/lightning_gepa.py`, `agent_braid/lightning_apo.py`) MUST use the paired selection of REQ-008 to REQ-011 for splits under this specification; their candidate target stays the skill body.

scenarios.given: the diff of every task
scenarios.then: no frozen path changed

requirements.text: Frozen records untouched. This specification MUST NOT edit the SPEC-069 scorer or prompt sets, the SPEC-078 or SPEC-079 splits, protocols or FREEZE files.

scenarios.given: a held-out or audit run configuration
scenarios.then: any allocation other than the fixed uniform schedule is refused

requirements.text: No adaptive allocation in frozen data. Held-out and audit data MUST NOT be collected with adaptive allocation, including Thompson Sampling.

scenarios.given: a rollout environment holding a provider key variable
scenarios.then: it is rejected before any rollout, as SPEC-071 does, and the key value appears in no record

requirements.text: Cost and route. A run MUST NOT read or accept a provider API key or other secret; it uses the subscription route at EUR 0 only.

scenarios.given: a gate report
scenarios.then: no such quantity appears

requirements.text: No non-identified gate quantity. Gate A MUST NOT report, as a gate quantity, the share of prompts whose p is below a threshold, with p, a prompt's per-repetition probability of a valid first attempt.

scenarios.given: a candidate split that shares a normalized 8-word window with v2, v3 or v4
scenarios.then: it refuses

requirements.text: Fresh gate A held-out split. Gate A under this specification MUST use a fresh split: one that shares no prompt, fingerprint or normalized 8-word window with the spent v2, v3 or v4 sets.

scenarios.given: a passed gate
scenarios.then: no promotion pointer changes and `executionAuthorization` is false

requirements.text: Human promotion. A gate A pass MUST NOT promote a candidate; promotion stays human under SPEC-073 with SPEC-049 noninferiority.

scenarios.given: a gate A report
scenarios.then: only the exact bounds of REQ-002 and REQ-003 and the class rule appear

requirements.text: No Wilson verdict. Gate A MUST NOT use the Wilson interval as its verdict statistic (split from REQ-002).

scenarios.given: a selection call given an audit item identifier
scenarios.then: it is rejected

requirements.text: Audit set not read by selection. Selection MUST NOT read any audit set item (split from REQ-012).

scenarios.given: the SPEC-079 v4 run directory
scenarios.then: it is rejected as out of scope
scenarios.when: the gate A analysis is invoked on it

requirements.text: No retroactive gate. The gate A rules of this specification MUST NOT be applied to the SPEC-079 v4 run or any split frozen before this specification (split from REQ-020).

scenarios.given: a reward configuration naming a model-graded component
scenarios.then: it is rejected

requirements.text: No LLM judge. A run MUST NOT use an LLM judge as a reward, label or gate source (split from REQ-022).

scenarios.given: a review record built from a transcript holding a planted secret marker
scenarios.then: the marker appears nowhere in the record

requirements.text: Redacted review records. The 0/3 review record MUST contain only transcripts redacted under SPEC-074, so that no unredacted prompt, file content, personal data or secret enters it.

scenarios.given: a requested slice of 5 prompts at the OD-4 power and the OD-3 δ and Δ
scenarios.then: it is rejected as underpowered with the needed size in the message

requirements.text: Minimum testable slice. The sizing function MUST reject a slice whose power at the target advantage Δ, from the plan.md formula, is below the OD-4 power, and MUST name the needed size. A 5-prompt slice is underpowered: a two-sided exact McNemar test cannot reach 0.05 (smallest p-value 0.0625), a one-sided exact sign test reaches 1/32 only when all five pairs are discordant in one direction, and McNemar's n counts discordant pairs only (split from REQ-009).

scenarios.given: a gate A noise pilot run
scenarios.then: it holds the correlation, the paired-difference variance, the discordance rate and A/A differences with intervals in the sizing input format

requirements.text: Gate A noise pilot. Before the slice is sized, a gate A noise pilot MUST run in the current laboratory on fresh development prompts that name the product, at the size of OD-14, and estimate the within-prompt correlation, the variance of paired per-prompt differences between two candidate arms, their discordance rate and A/A drift, each with an interval.

scenarios.given: a clustered scenario with nonzero between-class variance
scenarios.then: type I error, power and coverage are reported per variance and compared with the OD-15 tolerance
scenarios.when: the gate A and all-fail simulations run

requirements.text: Template-clustered simulation. The simulations of T004 and T005 MUST include a template-clustered scenario in which prompts of one template or class share a latent effect on p, over a grid of between-class variances, and report type I error, power and coverage under it against the tolerance of OD-15.

scenarios.given: a confirmation slice sharing one prompt with the elimination slice
scenarios.then: it is rejected

requirements.text: Confirmation slice. The replacement test of REQ-011 MUST run on a confirmation slice frozen by sha256 before elimination starts and disjoint by prompt, fingerprint and normalized text from the elimination slice, so that no elimination result enters the test.

scenarios.given: three challengers reaching confirmation with raw p-values 0.01, 0.02 and 0.04 at family-wise α 0.05
scenarios.then: Holm rejects only the first two

requirements.text: Family-wise error. When more than one challenger reaches the confirmation test, the tests MUST be adjusted by Holm over that family at the family-wise α of OD-16.

scenarios.given: a second audit scoring of the same winner, or an audit result passed to a choice between runs
scenarios.then: it is rejected

requirements.text: Audit scored once per winner. The audit set MUST be scored once for each selected winner, and its result is never an input to a choice between runs, candidates or configurations.

scenarios.given: a held-out run stopped by quota after which the host version changed
scenarios.then: it is rejected, the verdict is invalidated and the split is marked spent

scenarios.given: a run stopped by quota with the host unchanged
scenarios.then: only the missing slots run, in frozen order, and completed slots are untouched

requirements.text: Stops, host changes and resume. A quota stop or a host or model change MUST stop the session with every completed rollout kept. A resume runs only on the same frozen bytes and the same pinned host and model, and fills exactly the missing (prompt, repetition) slots in their frozen order, never rerunning a completed slot or drawing a new prompt. When a host or model change blocks the resume of a held-out split, the run is `invalidated`, the split is spent and it is not rescored. SPEC-091 applies this rule unchanged.

scenarios.given: a run with an unreviewed 0/3 prompt and a canary hit
scenarios.then: it is invalidated

scenarios.given: a run whose lower bound and class rule hold but whose all-fail bound exceeds τ
scenarios.then: it is missed

requirements.text: Gate A verdict. The gate A verdict MUST be `met` only when the passing-share lower bound, the all-fail upper bound and the class rule all hold; requiring every condition keeps a false `met` at or below α by the intersection–union principle. Precedence is `invalidated` over `held` over `missed` and `met`: an invalidating event gives `invalidated`; otherwise an unreviewed 0/3 prompt or an unfilled resumable slot gives `held`; otherwise `met` or `missed`.

scenarios.given: a pilot run whose prompt file hash differs from the pilot freeze
scenarios.then: it is rejected

requirements.text: Development pilot freeze. A development pilot (T020) MUST run only after its protocol section, its prompts and the arms under test are frozen by sha256 on a `develop` commit; pilot prompts are development prompts and never enter a held-out split, reserve, twin or audit set.

scenarios.given: an A/A difference above the threshold
scenarios.then: the OD-19 action is applied and recorded

requirements.text: A/A drift rule. When an A/A anchor difference exceeds the threshold of OD-19, the runner MUST apply the OD-19 action to that session before its results enter any decision.

scenarios.given: a session cap smaller than the sized slice
scenarios.then: it is rejected with the needed size

requirements.text: Selection stopping rule. Selection rounds MUST stop when one candidate survives or the OD-4 slice budget is spent, then go to the confirmation test; the configurator rejects a quota cap that would leave the slice below its REQ-031 size rather than shrinking the slice.

scientific_limits: Simulations show properties of the procedures under their stated models only; real prompts are templated and clustered, so independence across prompts is an assumption; one host and model per run; cited 2026 preprints are leads; nothing is claimed about other hosts or real sessions.
scope: Braid Lightning evaluation v2 (ADR 0046): exact gate A estimands, the all-fail bound with reserve replacement, paired synchronized selection with an incumbent margin, an audit set, drift controls, a Gate 0 invocation tripwire, run metadata and simulation tests before any real run.
